pricing.title: Free forever, and here is why
pricing.lead: One plan, no tiers, no card. The unusual part is not the price — it is that nothing is held back — so this page explains what that means and what it does not.
pricing.planNote: Everything in the product, for every member of your staff, with no expiry date.
pricing.assuranceTitle: Free usually has a catch. These are the three things worth asking about.
pricing.ctaLead: There is no commitment to make and no card to enter, so the only way to find out if it fits is to use it.

why.title: Why is it free?
why.body: AIM ENTERPRISE builds this for the repair trade it already works in. It is not funded by advertising and your data is not the product — if that ever changes, it will be said plainly here first.

data.title: Whose data is it?
data.body: Yours. Backup & Restore inside the app exports everything you have entered, at any time, without asking anyone.

noLockIn.title: Can I leave?
noLockIn.body: Yes, and you can take your data with you as CSV or Excel. Nothing here is designed to make leaving expensive.

hero.badge: Free forever for every repair shop
hero.titleLead: Run your whole repair shop on
hero.subtitle: From the moment a customer walks in to the moment they collect a repaired device — job cards, technician workflows, WhatsApp updates, billing, payments and warranty in one connected system.

replaces.spreadsheet: Excel sheets for stock and dues

capabilities.title: Not another billing tool. A complete system for running the business.
capabilities.lead: Every part of a repair shop that normally lives in someone’s head, a notebook or a chat thread — given a place in the software.

jobCards.title: Job cards that run themselves
jobCards.body: A dynamic intake form for every device type, actions that unlock only at the right status, and a full audit timeline on every job — so nobody has to remember what happened or ask who touched it last.

workflows.title: Technician workflows
workflows.body: Who can see what, and do what, at every status — configured by you, enforced everywhere.

updates.title: Customers stay informed
updates.body: Automatic WhatsApp updates when a device is received, in progress, or ready for pickup.

money.title: Billing and payments
money.body: Advances, part payments and final bills all reconcile into one ledger automatically.

secondHand.title: Second-hand trading
secondHand.body: Buy, refurbish and sell used devices with purchase-to-sale profit tracked per unit.

access.title: Access you actually control
access.body: Every menu and every action is gated by a permission you set, not hardcoded by us. A salesman never sees purchase cost, a technician never sees the ledger, and you decide the rest — down to the individual button.

workflow.title: From intake to delivery, one path
workflow.lead: Every job follows the same connected path, with no spreadsheet in between.

intake.title: Intake
intake.body: Find the customer or add them, capture the device details and the reported problem.

assign.title: Assign and repair
assign.body: A technician picks up the job. Status, parts used and cost are tracked as work happens.

bill.title: Bill and collect
bill.body: Generate the bill, take payment by any mode, and the ledgers update themselves.

deliver.title: Deliver with warranty
deliver.body: Hand over the device with a printed warranty note the customer can hold on to.

language.title: Your staff work in the language they think in
language.lead: The entire system — every screen, every button, every report — in English, Hindi and Gujarati. Each person picks their own; nobody has to work around somebody else’s choice.

about.title: The company behind the software
about.lead: Before you put your customers and your accounts into someone else’s software, it is fair to know who they are.
about.story1: Most repair shops in India run on a notebook at the counter, a WhatsApp thread per customer, and an Excel sheet somebody updates on Sundays. It works, right up to the point where two of the three disagree.
about.story2: The software that claims to fix this is usually either a billing app that knows nothing about repairs, or a large ERP priced and shaped for a factory. Neither knows what a job card is, or that the person typing at the counter may not be comfortable in English.
about.story3: So this was built around the job card instead of around the invoice, in three languages from the start, and given away — because a shop that cannot afford software is exactly the shop that needs it.
about.builtForValue: Mobile and electronics repair shops, and second-hand device dealers
about.principlesTitle: Four things we decided at the start

oneSystem.title: One system, not five
oneSystem.body: If a number has to be typed twice, we have not finished the feature.

everyone.title: Everyone reads it
everyone.body: Three languages and a real accessibility toolbar, not an afterthought.

realShops.title: Shaped by real shops
realShops.body: Built around the job card, because that is what the counter actually works from.

yourData.title: Your data stays yours
yourData.body: Exportable at any time, and never sold to anyone.

faq.title: Questions, answered plainly
faq.lead: Grouped so you can read the part that worries you and skip the rest.
faq.ctaLead: Ask on WhatsApp and a person will reply, usually the same day.

reallyFree.a: Yes. Every feature, for unlimited staff and jobs, with no card and no expiry date.

catch.a: There is no advertising, and your data is not sold or used as the product. Support is best-effort over WhatsApp and email rather than a contracted response time — that is the honest trade.

futureCharge.a: If that ever changes it will be said plainly on this site first, and your existing data will remain exportable either way.

hiddenLimits.a: No caps on job cards, customers, staff or branches. The only real limits are your device and your internet connection.

migration.q: Can I bring my existing data?
migration.a: Yes. Send whatever you have — Excel, a billing app export, even photographs of a register — and we will help move it in.

ownData.a: You do. It is your shop’s record of your own customers and accounts.

export.q: Can I get my data out?
export.a: Yes, at any time. Backup & Restore exports a full copy, and every list screen exports to CSV or Excel.

backup.a: Your data sits in Google Cloud Firestore, which is replicated by Google. You can also take your own copy whenever you like from Backup & Restore.

security.q: Can another shop see my data?
security.a: No. Every record is scoped to your company, and the database rules reject a read from any account that does not belong to it — the check is on the server, not just in the app.

mobile.q: Does it work on a phone?
mobile.a: Yes. It installs to the home screen like an app and every screen is built for a phone as well as a desktop.

offline.a: Screens you have already opened keep working from a local copy, and changes sync once the connection returns.

training.a: Creating a job card is designed to be faster than writing it in the notebook. For the rest, ask on WhatsApp and we will walk through it.

printer.q: Will it print on my printer?
printer.a: Bills and labels print through your browser, so any printer already set up on that computer works. Formats are editable in the print designer.

whatsapp.a: The app prepares the message from your template and opens WhatsApp with it ready to send, so it goes from your own number.

permissions.a: Yes, down to the individual menu and button. A salesman need never see purchase cost, and a technician need never see the ledger.

staffCount.q: How many staff can I add?
staffCount.a: As many as you need. There is no per-user charge.

branches.q: Does it handle more than one shop?
branches.a: Yes. Add a branch per location, scope staff to their own, and the owner sees all of them together.

languages.q: Can two people use different languages?
languages.a: Yes. Language is per person, not per shop, so each account keeps its own choice.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: What this software stores, why, and what you can do about it.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Your account details (name, email and optional mobile number), your company and branch details, and the business records you enter — customers, job cards, payments and stock. We also record login events and an audit trail of changes made inside your company.

use.title: How it is used
use.body: Only to run the software for you: to show you your own records, to enforce the permissions you configure, and to let you print and export. It is not used for advertising and is not sold or shared for marketing by anyone.

storage.title: Where it is stored
storage.body: In Google Cloud Firestore and Firebase Authentication, operated by Google. Your browser also keeps a local copy so the app keeps working when the connection drops.

sharing.title: Who else sees it
sharing.body: Only the accounts you create inside your own company, and only as far as the permissions you give them allow. Google acts as our infrastructure provider. We do not sell your data.

retention.title: How long it is kept
retention.body: For as long as your account is open. Business records such as job cards and payments are kept as a permanent record unless you ask for them to be removed.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can export a full copy at any time from Backup & Restore, correct anything through the app, and ask us in writing to delete your account and its data.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.body: We use browser storage to keep you signed in and to remember your language, theme and reading preferences. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.

children.title: Age
children.body: This is business software and is not intended for use by anyone under 18.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If this policy changes, the updated date above will change with it, and any material change will be stated plainly rather than buried in a revision.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: The agreement between your shop and AIM ENTERPRISE for using this software.

acceptance.title: Accepting these terms
acceptance.body: By creating an account you accept these terms on behalf of your business.

service.title: What is provided
service.body: Access to the software as it exists at the time, free of charge, for running a repair or second-hand-device business.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You are responsible for your password, for the staff accounts you create, and for the permissions you give them. Tell us promptly if you believe an account has been misused.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: Do not use it for anything unlawful, do not attempt to reach another company’s data, and do not try to disrupt the service for others.

yourData.title: Your data
yourData.body: The records you enter remain yours. You are responsible for their accuracy and for having the right to store the customer details you enter.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: We aim to keep the service running but do not promise uninterrupted availability. Since the service is free, no uptime guarantee is offered.

warranty.title: No warranty
warranty.body: The software is provided as it is. Keep your own exported copies of anything your business depends on.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: To the extent the law allows, AIM ENTERPRISE is not liable for business losses arising from use of the software.

termination.title: Ending the agreement
termination.body: You can stop using the service at any time and export your data first. We may suspend an account that breaks these terms.

governing.title: Governing law
governing.body: These terms are governed by the laws of India, with the courts of Gujarat having jurisdiction.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: If these terms change, the updated date above will change with them. Continuing to use the service means accepting the revised terms.
